_about: Chinese skill names per class and tree, transcribed verbatim from the 21 skill-tree pages at wiki.d.163.com. Kept separate from assets/skills/data/ on purpose: there is no established way to link a Chinese name to an individual English skill, because the wiki orders its tree by page heading while SkillDesc.txt orders the tree by a SkillColumn/SkillRow grid, and the two orders differ. Attaching names by position would put them on the wrong skills.
_provenance: wiki.d.163.com skill-tree category pages, 21 of 21 retrieved, 10 names per tree, 210 total. Fetched by a subagent that refused to translate, normalise or fill in from prior knowledge; every page was cross-checked against a second independent fetch method.
_verified: Set size: 7 classes x 3 trees x 10 = 210, matching Skills.txt's 30 skills per class.
Amazon bow and crossbow: all ten Chinese names map one-to-one onto the ten skills SkillDesc.txt puts on SkillPage 1 for the amazon, checked by hand.

Tree identity: the members of each page are self-evident from their names (page 1 of the sorceress holds only fire skills, page 2 only lightning, page 3 only cold), so the page numbers did not have to be named from outside.
_notVerified: Name-to-name equivalence for the other 20 trees. The sets agree in size and the trees agree in subject, but a per-skill pairing has not been established and is not implied by this file.

The wiki's ordering within a tree is its heading order (its own TOC 1.1-1.10), not level order. Two known spots: barbarian combat_masteries lists a level-24 before a level-18, and warcries lists a level-18 before a level-12.
_spellingQuirksPreserved: assassin martial_arts 5: the heading is 眼镜蛇攻击 (眼镜), while that page's own image filenames write 眼睛蛇攻击.
necromancer summoning 3: 粘土石魔 uses 粘, not 黏.
druid summoning 4: the heading is 召唤幽灵狼, while that skill's own body text says 召唤鬼狼.
sorceress fire 4: the heading is 炙烈之径, while the extra-info prose says 烈焰之径.
barbarian warcries 8: 残酷喝阻 (喝), while the prose says 残酷呵阻.
assassin shadow_disciplines 2: the heading is 心灵之锤, while a prerequisite line inside another section writes 心灵战锤.
_warning: 加速 appears in two different classes (amazon passive_and_magic and assassin shadow_disciplines). They are different skills and must not be collapsed.
